scripts.zigbee: bun run zigbee:setup && bun ./node_modules/zigbee2mqtt/index.js writehash && ZIGBEE2MQTT_DATA=$PWD/data/zigbee2mqtt Z2M_ONBOARD_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8081 bun ./node_modules/zigbee2mqtt/index.js
scripts.zigbee:setup: mkdir -p data/zigbee2mqtt && if [ ! -f data/zigbee2mqtt/configuration.yaml ]; then cp config/zigbee2mqtt.example.yaml data/zigbee2mqtt/configuration.yaml && chmod 600 data/zigbee2mqtt/configuration.yaml; fi
